name: Setup Virtual List Table
purpose: Developer set-up of the Generator file's virtual list table: makes sure the VIRTUALLIST table holds exactly 1000 records (deleting all if there are more, adding rows up to 1000) and numbers them 1 to 1000 with Replace Field Contents if the last one is not 1000. Its effect would be client-ui (a display helper).
writes:
VIRTUALLIST::n#1 (step 16, found set from step 4 (all records))
delete: VIRTUALLIST (Delete All Records step 6, all records, only when more than 1000 exist)
new record: VIRTUALLIST (New Record/Request step 11, repeated up to 1000 rows)
open_question: Replace Field Contents at step 16 runs on the found set after Show All Records (step 4), so every row is renumbered. Called only by Prep (script 40). The Generator file is a build-time code generator for the Create ... { data } style scripts; confirm the target does not need it.
